kind: Body-only native terminal reply facade candidate
status: design only; no implementation or paid rerun; P139 remains failed
motivation: P139 OpenCode StructuredOutput marked valid a final string true. Host correctly rejected it. Native terminal reply mode already carries final intent, so asking the model for the same boolean may be redundant.
notCoercion: Do not convert string true to boolean. Under the proposed body-only schema any extra final key remains invalid. Existing P139 body/final schema and failed verdict are unchanged.
hostOptIn: Host explicitly selects this terminal reply facade for this particular activated native turn. A frozen descriptor records facade kind, schema identity/hash, native session, current prompt identity, RunAttempt/execution binding, unique authorized target and presentedThroughSeq.

The OpenCode built-in function is still StructuredOutput. Its generic name alone does not authorize publication. Only the current invocation explicitly using the approved LoomFinalReply schema is eligible.
acceptanceChecks: Return belongs to the exact awaited current native invocation; current assistant ID is newly produced, parent is the newly persisted current business prompt, session and configured model match.

Exactly one completed StructuredOutput capture with nonempty call ID belongs to that same assistant/session. Tool input and captured structured object match. Native tool batch and response have settled with durable usage and no unresolved failure.
Host independently enforces object shape: body string only, nonempty and bounded; rejects all other properties. Native metadata.valid and JSON-schema declaration are not trusted as validation.
No arbitrary stdout text, CLI exit, generic assistant final text, historical latest message or tool status alone becomes a Room action.

workerCommandConstruction.basedOnRoomSeq: Host-frozen presentedThroughSeq; never reread current room seq to bypass stale hold
workerCommandConstruction.idempotencyKey: stable from this authorized current capture/Run binding, not a new retry key

publicationAndCompletion: Send through the same authenticated Worker application service and Kernel as ordinary MCP. Preserve ACL, execution fence, unique target, idempotency and stale-context hold.

Native StructuredOutput success means intent capture only. Only real Worker published receipt confirms Room publication. Held/error/unknown does not complete the Activation or imply successful delivery.
Persist successful receipt into the same native session as explicitly labeled synthetic Host diagnostic with noReply. Never create a Room Human message or task.

If Room publication succeeds but session receipt write fails or is unknown, retain partial/unknown status, reconcile existing native receipt identity before writing again, and never resend original business mutation with a fresh key.
Finalize actual native runtime provenance even on Host intent rejection; do not leave RunAttempt running merely because validation failed. Activation remains incomplete on failure.
progressBoundary: This facade is exclusively an explicit final reply. Progress updates must use an independently declared ordinary MCP/Worker action; they do not enter this terminal facade.
Kimi and generic MCP tools can publish either progress or final replies and lack this native final-event mode. Do not remove their final field by analogy or treat any tool call as terminal.
requiredFreeTests: Body-only valid capture yields exactly one real published message and final marker, receipt persists without additional generation and same session continues.
Wrong schema descriptor, wrong session/parent, stale capture, duplicate capture, plain text final, extra final property, empty body and unresolved sibling tools all reject before Worker call.
Newer Human facts produce real Worker held response, no successful receipt/completion.
Published then lost response / native receipt write failure never creates duplicate Room write; restoration reads authoritative state.
RunAttempt receives true exit provenance even when schema validation rejects intent; Activation does not complete.
evaluation: If approved for the next experiment, pre-register one new interface version and paid sample; do not overwrite P139, reuse its sample as a pass, or compare its truncated costs as a full long-task ratio.
productContract: Standalone design candidate; production adoption changes the permitted native output submission boundary and needs explicit owner contract approval. No production adapter or protocol changed.
